name: @farishan-labs/ui
description: Headless UI primitives + W3C DTCG tokens for Faris Han Labs (web components, a11y-first).

scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run gen:tokens && bun build src/index.ts src/adapters/index.ts src/adapters/ui-sdk.ts --outdir dist --target browser --entry-naming [dir]/[name].js && bun run build:tokens
scripts.build:adapters: bun build src/adapters/index.ts src/adapters/ui-sdk.ts --outdir dist --target browser --entry-naming [dir]/[name].js
scripts.build:tokens: cp src/tokens/tokens/tokens.css dist/tokens.css && cp src/baseline.css dist/baseline.css
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run typecheck
scripts.docs:build: bun run build && rm -rf docs-dist && mkdir -p docs-dist && cp -r docs-site/. docs-dist/ && cp -r docs docs-dist/docs
